summary: In an 8-K filed July 10, 2026, NXG Cushing Midstream Energy Fund reported that NXG Cushing, LLC, owned by senior employees of the adviser Cushing Asset Management, LP, acquired a 62% aggregate interest in the adviser from founder Jerry V. Swank, and replaced Swank Capital, LLC as general partner. This change-of-control triggered termination of the prior advisory agreement and entry into a new agreement with materially identical terms. The annual meeting of shareholders approved the new agreement and elected trustees. No financial terms of the acquisition or premium were disclosed. Watch for further regulatory filings confirming the adviser's updated ownership and any potential impact on fund performance.
